text:
mira: Heads-up — hit a 413 when sending a mixed-dim embeddings batch from the new client SDK. small repro below.

kevin: ugh. do you have the exact payload?

mira: yeah, sending array of vectors where first two are 768, the rest 512. API returns 413 with message 'payload too large' but logs show dimension mismatch + size.

mira: example request:```
POST /v1/embeddings
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {"input": [[...768 floats...], [...768 floats...], [...512 floats...], ...]}
Headers: {"X-Client-SDK":"js-1.4.2"}
```

jordan: can you paste the exact log line from the gateway? we log both bytes and dim hints.

mira: gateway log: `embed.gateway: request_id=rid-472 dim_hint=[768,768,512,...] bytes=2.4MB result=reject code=413 reason="mixed dims and over-size"`

aria: hmm, this is the long-standing ambig issue: clients assume server splits mixed dims but our splitter expects uniform dims or explicit per-vector-dim header. we default to fail on ambiguous batches.

kevin: right. we currently have two levers: 1) preflight validation in the gateway that rejects early (current behavior), 2) attempt best-effort split/route which can increase latency and CPU.

mira: the surprising part is the UX — client sees 413 generic, and console shows only "request rejected" with no guidance. customers blame quota/size limits not dims.

jordan: telemetry also aggregates these into embed.request.rejects, so we lose the actual cause unless we tag rejects by reason. we should add a tag `reject_reason=dim_mismatch` and `reject_reason=payload_bytes` now.

aria: agreed. small fixes: add tagged metrics, surface human-friendly message in 413 payload, and add Console hint linking to our docs with sample fix.

kevin: longer-term debate: should SDKs do soft-preflight and split into multiple calls automatically? pros: better UX, fewer support tickets. cons: more traffic, harder billing clarity, can break strict quota semantics.

mira: SDK auto-splitting would be sweet for PLG customers. But for enterprise/dedicated we may need an opt-in flag.

jordan: operationally we can gate auto-split behind a feature flag `embeds.sdk_auto_split` and default off for enterprise orgs. rollout plan: start at 1% canary, watch `embed.batch_latency_p95`, `embed.request_count`, and `embed.split_failures`.

aria: console UX idea: show an on-route preflight toggle "Reject mixed-dim batches" with description and preview of what auto-split would do. When enabled, show estimated extra calls and cost impact.

kevin: that preview needs routing telemetry: how many customer requests per day would have been auto-split and cost delta. We can compute from logs if we start tagging dims.

mira: for immediate fix: can we change gateway 413 message to include `hint: include X-Vector-Dims:[512,768] header or split into uniform batches` ?

kevin: yes. small PR to gateway + docs update. Also add metric `embed.reject.dim_mismatch` and a debug counter `embed.split.attempts` (counts attempts to auto-split).

jordan: I'll mock the Console panel for the preflight toggle and the cost-preview chart. will add a wireframe to the design Figma and link it in this thread.

aria: action items:
- kevin: add gateway change + metrics + 413 hint (PR & unit tests)
- jordan: console mock + Figma + quick telemetry query for preview
- mira: collect 5 recent examples and paste payloads for telemetry sampling
- aria: draft SDK proposal for optional auto-split and billing note

mira: thanks. ping me on the PR, I'll validate with customer repro. :thumbsup:

build-bot: deploy-canary: embeds-gateway v3.2.1 started canary on eng-canary cluster

kevin: noted. will coordinate tests with canary and watch the new metrics.

mira: timeline?

kevin: aim to have small gateway change + metric tagging in 48h. console mock in 1 week. SDK proposal in 2 weeks.

aria: I'll open a GH issue for the SDK RFC and add the rollout checklist.

mira: perfect. thanks all."
